name: OTel-LLM-8B-A1B-IT
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2.5-8B-A1B (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2.5-8B-A1B: 6 full GQA layers (kv heads 8, head_dim 64) and 18 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-8B-A1B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 8.47 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-06-17.

benchmarks.name: OTel-LLM LLM-as-judge correctness
benchmarks.config: Card 'OTel vs. Base Model' table, column 'Base model' 81.2% vs 'OTel fine-tuned' 88.4% +/- 0.5 (+7.2 pp). OTel-LLM held-out 10%, two judges, bootstrap n=1000. Private telecom corpus, in-domain. Card notes this release postdates the OTel paper and is not in its 30-model baseline table.
